skills.name: calculate-freelance-project-quote
skills.description: Calculate and explain an INR freelance or small-studio project quote from six bounded assumptions. Use when a user wants a fee estimate, quote range, or pricing rationale for brand, website, product, development, strategy, or consulting work in India.

skills.name: draft-overdue-invoice-follow-up
skills.description: Calculate an overdue INR invoice balance and draft a factual payment follow-up. Use when an Indian freelancer or small studio needs a gentle reminder, firm follow-up, or final payment request without sharing client identity or invoice documents.
